headline: Ivanti patches two more exploited Connect Secure zero-days on KEV deadline day; VOLTA infostealer and Binance heist remain top stories

bullets.text: New since the last SITREP: SecurityWeek reports Ivanti has patched two more zero-days exploited in the Connect Secure attack chain, CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527.

The first CISA KEV due date for Ivanti Connect Secure is today, 2026-11-02; the second is 2026-11-13. Attackers are chaining three flaws (CVE-2026-104935, CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527) to gain unauthenticated root access.
The Hacker News reports a new VOLTA infostealer that uses Claude, Gemini and Kimi AI to rank victims by financial value.
CISA KEV due dates for the max-severity GitLab CE/EE flaw CVE-2026-97229 and the Cisco ASA/FTD flaw CVE-2026-76418 passed on 2026-11-01. Alpine Linux rebuilt its GitLab after an attempted RCE attack.

The FBI links the Binance crypto heist to North Korean hackers. BleepingComputer gives $6.3 billion; The Hacker News names the TraderTraitor group and gives $6.43 billion. Binance earlier tied the theft to a compromised DevOps laptop.
The official Claude Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace was trojanized with a persistent SSH backdoor; WIRED reports malicious Claude extensions reached thousands of devices.

actions: Apply Ivanti's latest Connect Secure patches today, covering CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527, and check appliances for the chained root compromise.
If GitLab CE/EE (CVE-2026-97229) or Cisco ASA/FTD (CVE-2026-76418) are still unpatched, patch now; both KEV due dates have passed.
Find any LXD and MicroCloud deployments, check the vendor advisory for the CVSS 10.0 flaw, and patch them.
Update Drupal Commerce Core for the actively exploited CVE-2026-118539 and check sites for unauthorized access.
If developers use the Claude Code extension in Cursor, check it against the vendor advisory and look for unexpected SSH keys or services.
If you store AI provider API keys in Northflank, rotate them and review provider usage and billing for abuse.
